analysis_plan.fold_assignment: source-defined template binding strata, outcome-independent hash ordering
analysis_plan.selection: minimum pooled inner-OOF Brier; ties use first declared l2; refit outer training only

ensemble_method: mean of the fixed seeded OOF probabilities per target, never label-weighted

feature_manifest.information_identity: neutral_failure = not neutral_valid or neutral_prediction_value != oracle_answer_value
feature_manifest.limitation: Previously consumed discovery only. Oracle-assisted tiers have stronger information access. The explicit scored feature adds no observation once raw neutral response and source oracle are given; any remaining predictive increment there is a representation/capacity effect, not new evidence.
feature_manifest.source_oracle_evaluation_scope: feature construction only; excludes source/provenance validation

limitation: Exploratory nested grouped cross-validation on previously consumed discovery data, not M5 confirmation or a frozen unfamiliar-program forecast. No mechanism C, confidence or internal measurement feature is fitted. Repeated fold seeds reuse the same data and are not independent replications. Bootstrap intervals condition on the saved OOF predictions and do not rerun feature collection, model fitting or hyperparameter selection. Raw neutral behavior uses one distinct extra query without its oracle correctness; the scored tier additionally requires the neutral reference oracle. Target response properties and correctness never enter features. Capacity controls add fixed source-feature interactions. Source-oracle tiers additionally receive the program oracle value and its magnitude/sign without any target language-model response. On a source-oracle plus raw-neutral tier, neutral failure is a deterministic comparison of existing information, not a new observation; an increment can reflect the encoding capacity of the fitted function class.
